item.title: How Burp Decrypts HTTPS: CA, Fake Host Certs, and Two Session Keys
item.description: How Burp Proxy works on the wire: a self-signed CA, per-host certs signed with that CA key, two TLS sessions, and decrypt/encrypt with two different session keys. No install walkthrough.
